Congenital coalition of talus and navicular with associated skeletal fusion abnormalities.
Inherited erythroid marrow failure; thumb/upper-limb skeletal malformations occur in roughly 30-50% of RPL11 cases. Renal/cardiac defects are minority findings.

Bilateral corneal dystrophy with erosions, opacification and progressive visual impairment.
Although originating in nipple breast ducts, the defining erosive lesion directly damages overlying epidermis, with persistent crusting and erosion.
Isolated sperm flagellar dysfunction and male infertility; no endocrine failure or other organ disease established.
Pituitary GH excess with adenoma/hyperplasia; overgrowth alone does not establish organ damage. Visual field loss and arthralgia are under 30%.

Signet ring cell adenocarcinoma occupying the urinary bladder.
Progressive spastic paraplegia; fixed knee/ankle/toe contractures in 80-99% and skeletal muscle atrophy in 8/10. Optic atrophy is occasional (5-29%).
Primary ovarian insufficiency is gonadal endocrine failure; ocular annotations lack frequency evidence supporting involvement in at least 30%.
